notes:
- New perk: Fart Cloud. Sliding leaves a poison cloud behind you (the same gas a Bloater bursts into) for
  4 seconds. It hurts the zombies in it (a share of their health, so it still matters late on; bosses barely
  notice) and never hurts you or your team. Recharges in 9 seconds. Points come from the kills it gets.
- Perk upgrades (main menu > UPGRADES): every perk now has two skill trees of three tiers, bought with
  Viral Ooze. You earn ooze by surviving: 1 at round 5, 2 at round 10, 3 at 15, 4 at 20, 5 at 25, then
  more every 5 rounds up to 10 from round 40. Tiers cost 1, 3 and 5. The trees:
  - Iron Gut: *Thick Skin* (up to +50 max health), *Shrug It Off* (up to 15% less damage).
  - Quick Hands: *Sleight of Hand* (swap up to 55% faster), *Speed Loader* (reload up to 25% faster still).
  - Rapid Fire: *Steady Aim* (up to 45% less recoil), *Hair Trigger* (fire up to 15% faster still).
  - Fleet Foot: *Sprinter* (up to 15% faster still), *Slick Moves* (slides go up to 45% further).
  - Quick Fix: *Patch Up* (heal up to 60% faster), *Back in Action* (up to 3 s of safety after getting back
    up, revive up to 30% faster).
  - Heavy Handed: *Brawler* (melee up to 30% harder still), *Boot* (slide kicks up to twice as hard).
  - Fart Cloud: *Toxic* (up to double damage), *Gassy* (ready up to 4.5 s sooner).
- Zombies come out of the vents upstairs: the Laboratory's upper floor has ceiling vents. When you're up
  there, zombies burst the grate off (it clangs to the floor), drop through and land in a crouch.
- The Mystery Box and upgrade machine beams are much taller (40 m), so you can spot them from across the map.
- A hidden song: somewhere on every map there are three old radios. Find them... (the song itself comes in a
  later update; for now the radios are already hiding).
- Fixed: the TV floated above its stand.
- The spawn room always has at least two windows now. A zombie that can't reach its window is moved right up
  to it after 30 seconds (it used to be put back outside, where it could get stuck again).
